caption: The drawing depicts a single, horizontal object resembling an old-fashioned tool or mechanical part. On the left side, there is a metallic, curved hook attached to a cylindrical bar that extends to the right. The cylindrical section is colored in dark greenish-gray hues, giving it a metallic appearance. At the end of the cylindrical section, to the right, there is a bulbous, light-wooden or ivory-colored element with visible grain, which features two small, dark circular protrusions. This lighter section has spiraled circular designs at both ends. The background is plain and off-white, and the name “J. CANNELLA” is written in black in the lower right corner.
